notes.title: Shattered Horizon Update Released
notes.notes:
An update for Shattered Horizon is now available. The game will update automatically. 

The update adds the Last Stand pack, a free expansion that includes single player, online co-op and a new game mode. 

SHATTERED HORIZON 1.3.0.53
•	Play all game types in single player mode with bots.
•	Choose the number of bots and set the difficulty level, play for fun or challenge yourself to improve.
•	Play the new Last Stand game mode which pits a team of four against waves of increasingly difficult bot enemies.
•	Last Stand can be played with bots on your team in single player, or with friends in online co-op.

SHATTERED HORIZON SERVER 1.3.0.17
•	Server hosts can optionally add and configure bots for multiplayer games. 
•	Bots will leave a game to make room for real players, and rejoin to make up team numbers.

notes.title: Open Bot Beta - bot version 0.3 update
notes.notes:
We have just updated the bots running on the open bot beta servers. The update happens on our side so you won't need to download anything from Steam in order to play against the new bots. The new bots are live now on EU beta servers. The US beta servers will be updated this evening.

Bot version 0.3
The most noticeable changes include:

Bots now have individual aggression levels. Some will take cover when shot at and some will charge.
Each bot now has its own difficulty level parameter which affects its reaction time and accuracy.
Difficulty levels vary from 0: easy to 10: very hard and can also be set to Dynamic.
The default is Dynamic which changes the difficulty based on the K/D ratio of the targeted enemy.
Bots can now use machinegun and railgun. These bots can also use the pistol.
All bots now use melee attack when they get a good chance.
Enemies spotted by bot team mates now appear on player radars.


This is an open beta. Anyone with a copy of Shattered Horizon can join the Open Bot Beta servers. For more information and to give feedback please visit the forums.

notes.title: Open Bot Beta - bot version 0.2 update
notes.notes:
We have just updated the bots running on the open bot beta servers. The update happens on our side so you won't need to download anything from Steam in order to play against the new bots. 

Bot version 0.2
The most noticeable changes include:

Reduced shooting accuracy slightly for all weapons, more so for shotgun
Bots fight more defensively and make better use of cover
Bots can switch to a closer target when encountering multiple enemies
Bots use grenades more conservatively
Bots can do tactical reloads
Bots react better to control points being captured
Bots have slightly reduced ability to detect enemies over longer ranges 
Code now takes silent mode and thruster state into account for enemy detection


This is an open beta. Anyone with a copy of Shattered Horizon can join the Open Bot Beta servers. For more information and to give feedback please visit the forums.

notes.title: Shattered Horizon Update Released
notes.notes:
Shattered Horizon patch 1.2.1.28

An update patch for Shattered Horizon is now available. The game will update automatically.

This update makes several optimizations to engine code. Frame rates and general performance should improve noticeably particularly with low and mid range cards.

The winning conditions for Assault mode have been changed to reduce the number of matches ending in draws. A team now wins either by capturing more control points than the other team during the round, or 
by capturing all of the control points faster than the other team.

Server commands have been added allowing admins to edit the level cycle while the game is running. See the Shattered Horizon game manual for details.

Weekly leaderboards have been added to the Shattered Horizon website:
http://stats.shatteredhorizon.com/stats/weeklyLeaderBoards.action

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.26 - performance improvements
notes.notes:
An update patch for Shattered Horizon is now available. The game will update automatically. This patch makes several optimizations to engine code to improve overall performance and includes a few tweaks to weapon balance based on game stats and forum feedback from the first few days of play. 

SHATTERED HORIZON 1.2.0.26

Performance optimizations
Reload bugs fixed
The pistol's overall accuracy has been improved
The railgun is now more accurate when fired from a surface without using the scope
The railgun wobble after each shot and after zoom-in is a bit shorter
Player speed while using SMG or shotgun has been reduced slightly
Player speed while using machinegun has been increased slightly
We'd like to apologise to everyone who had a performance hit with the Firepower pack. Though this patch was sent to Steam on Monday, for whatever reason it has only just gone live today. Thank you for waiting patiently.
